project.name: sas-sdk
project.description: Builds the Java SDKs in one run: ue-android (Java 8 bytecode, minSdk 24, also runs on a plain JVM) and bank-backend (Java 25). Aggregator only, not a parent: each SDK keeps a standalone pom so it can be built and published on its own. Not part of the root sas-core reactor, so the server build never pulls in the SDKs. ue-ios (SwiftPM) and ue-web (npm) build with their own tools.
